channel.title: Tibo Time Monitor
channel.description: State-changing Codex / ChatGPT Work reset signals from @thsottiaux. Heartbeats are not included.

item.title: UNCERTAIN: Astra usage reset fully propagated
item.description: Tibo confirmed the Astra usage reset has fully propagated: "Reset all propagated. Sweet dreams." This follows the earlier announcement of a reset landing by midnight. Public monitor only; not per-account confirmation.

item.title: ACTIVE: Astra usage reset landing by midnight today
item.description: Tibo announced a reset for Astra users, landing by midnight today, alongside quality fixes for skills, context management, and engines. This is an automatic/global usage reset signal.

item.title: INACTIVE: Banked resets re-issued after a morning apply failure
item.description: Tibo said some banked resets did not fully apply this morning on ChatGPT Work and Codex. Affected users are getting another banked reset and an apology email. Banked-only events do not turn Tibo Time on.
